title: A large gain answered "wrong" removes that check and asks for the figure again (decision Z1)
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027, after pay on Fri 25 Dec. The bank holds 100,000 (30,000 of it Free to spend left), the e-wallet 5,000, the cash 10,000. Pay of 250,000 on the 25th starts the period; Free to spend is 60,000 a month. At the check-in on Fri 8 Jan at 20:00 the person types 101,000 for the bank, 280,000 for the e-wallet (the bank's figure typed in the wrong box) and 13,000 for the cash. Every amount is made up. The person answers the cash question: the 13,000 is wrong (`gain: wrong`; they typed the e-wallet's figure in the cash box). The e-wallet question is still asked (`gain: asked`). A check answered wrong is removed (marked gone) and the figure is asked again.
